about_meta_title: About NRG Glass | NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd.
about_meta_description: Founded in 1970, NRG Glass focuses on laboratory glassware, hydrometers, and thermometers, with specification, manufacturing, and sourcing support.
story_identity: NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd. is the legal entity registered in Taiwan as 巧新有限公司. NRG Glass is its laboratory glassware trading brand.
story_history: The business traces its glass-instrument work to Guang Ming Glass Instrument Co., founded in 1970 to produce glass hydrometers and thermometers. The company was reorganized as NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd. in 1990.
story_services: Direct manufacturing, complementary labware sourcing, and custom specification requests are separate service paths. Product origin, material, dimensions, and other requirements are confirmed at product or quotation level.
story_capabilities_cta: Review capabilities and prepare a project brief
milestone_1970_desc:
Founded Guang Ming Glass Instrument Co.; began production of glass hydrometers and thermometers.
Launched “Shin Kong Instruments” as a retail distribution channel.
milestone_1990_desc: Reorganized as NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd.; expanded production to China.
milestone_2011_desc: Expanded into kitchen and tabletop glassware.
milestone_present_desc: Ongoing growth in manufacturing, quality, and sourcing capabilities.
capabilities_meta_title: Custom & OEM Glassware Capabilities | NRG Glass
capabilities_meta_description: Review NRG Glass manufacturing, complementary sourcing, and case-by-case custom specification support for laboratory glassware procurement.
capabilities_intro: NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd., trading as NRG Glass, supports institutional buyers, laboratories, and distributors with clearly scoped manufacturing, sourcing, and custom-review paths.
capabilities_manufacturing: Our verified manufacturing history began with glass hydrometers and thermometers. Current manufacturing scope is confirmed for each requested product and specification during quotation.
capabilities_sourcing: We can source complementary laboratory glassware when a project requires items outside the directly manufactured range. A catalog listing does not by itself mean that the item is manufactured in-house.
capabilities_custom: Custom and OEM requests are reviewed individually against the product type, dimensions, intended application, quantity, and destination. Feasibility is not implied until confirmed in writing.
capabilities_breadth: The catalog includes more than 300 SKUs across laboratory glassware and related instrument categories. Material and performance statements apply only where shown on the relevant product record.
capabilities_boundaries: Material grade, dimensions, tolerances, thermal or chemical performance, minimum quantities, lead times, and product origin must be verified for the specific item and quotation.
capabilities_brief_intro: Include these details so the team can perform a substantive review:
capabilities_brief_product: Product type and catalog or reference link

capabilities_photo_tubes: Representative laboratory tubes from the NRG Glass product range.
capabilities_photo_hydrometers: Representative hydrometers from the NRG Glass product range.
capabilities_cta_heading: Discuss a Purchasing or Custom Project
capabilities_cta_body: Send a project brief for an initial scope review. We aim to respond within two business days.
privacy_meta_description: How NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd. handles inquiry details submitted through the NRG Glass website.
privacy_intro: This notice explains how NEW GLATEC Co., Ltd. handles information submitted through the NRG Glass inquiry form.
privacy_purpose: We use inquiry information to review your request, correspond with you, prepare follow-up questions or a quotation, and protect the form from abuse. The form collects your name, email address, message, and any company, phone, inquiry type, or product information you choose to provide.
privacy_processors_heading: Services Used to Process an Inquiry
privacy_processors: Cloudflare delivers and protects the website, provides Turnstile verification, and processes the inquiry through Cloudflare Workers and related delivery services. Inquiry details are delivered by email to the responsible recipient. These providers process data only as needed to operate those services.
privacy_maps: The contact page embeds Google Maps. Loading the map may send device, network, and usage information to Google under Google's own privacy terms. You can contact us without using the map.
privacy_retention: Inquiry correspondence is retained for up to 12 months, except when an active customer relationship, contract, dispute, or legal obligation requires longer retention.
privacy_rights: You may ask to access, correct, or delete inquiry information, subject to applicable legal and business record requirements. Contact us at contact@nrglabware.com and identify the inquiry so we can respond.
contact_meta_description: Send NRG Glass a laboratory glassware purchasing or custom-specification inquiry. Include the product, dimensions, quantity, destination, and a reference link when available.
